request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and storytelling, acoustic guitar, banjo, fiddle, upright bass, mandolin, gentle folk mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family history of Esau, that is, Edom
He took his wives from the daughters of Canaan
Adah daughter of Elon, and Oholibamah
And Basemath daughter of Ishmael

[Verse]
Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau in the land
And Basemath bore Reuel, sons born in Canaan
Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah
Their possessions were too great for them to live together

[Pre-Chorus]
The land where they were staying could not support them
Because of their livestock, they had to move away

[Chorus]
So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir
He moved to another land, away from his brother Jacob
This is the family history of Esau, the father of the Edomites

[Verse]
Eliphaz son of Adah, Reuel son of Basemath
Chiefs descended from them in the land of Edom
Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, and Amalek
These were the chiefs among Esau's descendants

[Chorus]
So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir
He moved to another land, away from his brother Jacob
This is the family history of Esau, the father of the Edomites

[Bridge]
Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon
Ezer, and Dishan, the Horite chiefs in the land
Seir the Horite lived there before the kings came

[Chorus]
So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir
He moved to another land, away from his brother Jacob
This is the family history of Esau, the father of the Edomites

[Outro]
These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements
This was Esau, the father of the Edomites
